text.p: Somanetics Corp said Wednesday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 1,800,000 common shares, plus an over-allotment of 270,000 shares.
The offering will be made through a group of underwriters managed by Brean Murray & Co Inc of New York.
Proceeds of the sale will be used to finance increased marketing and sales activities, expanded research and development programs and other general corporate purposes.
Somanetics makes and markets the INVOS 3100A cerebral oximeter, a non-invasive patient monitoring system that measures changes in the blood oxygen level in the adult brain.

The company said its development activities include a cerebral oximeter for use on children and newborns, as well as the development of products through its consulting arrangement with NeuroPhysics Corp.
